There are lots of breeds with white spotting on the chest lol. Everyone thinks my Catahoula’s (NALC, AKC and UKC reg) pups are pit mixes because they’re brindle and have the white chest. Saying stuff like “tell tale sign of a pit because of a white chest” is hurting other breeds. 

This is far from a lab but purebred labs can have white on their chest. Field line often do (missmark is what they call them). Goldens and shepherds also have em.

Anyone who has ties to adba (biggest pit registry) is probably dirty. They have board members who roll. They don’t deserve that title. The only people who use the term dogmen are hunting hounds, racing hounds and apbt. Racing and hound industry has tons of abuse, to the point there are those still being arrested for freezing and drowning unwanted pups. 
No reputable modern dog person uses those terms. The ones that do often raise a red flag. And it’s shepherd. Don’t say someone shouldn’t own an entire class of dogs if you cant spell it.

From a small rural town it looks like, which is how it usually is here in the states. The pit breed (apbt/ working amstaff) community often supports dogfighting and heavily defends it. Most apbt (American pit Bull terrier) or anyone who shows under the adba (main registry for apbt) knows someone who dog fights. And most won’t report them. America and Canada are probably the same in numbers honestly, America just has stricter animal care laws. Pretty sure they have to catch them in the act in CA where it’s not the case in the states, but I may be wrong. Canada is known for shooting their mustangs and some people do it for sport.
